events.name: Providence College Late Night Madness! ft. Kelly Clarkson
Summer Flow
events.info: SUMMER FLOW brings the energy of Cabo Verde's new generation of music to the U.S. for an unforgettable end-of-summer celebration. Headlining the night are rising Cabo Verdean stars Puto Fox and Alyrio, both making their highly anticipated U.S. performance debuts. They'll be joined by one of Cabo Verde's all-time favorite rappers, Djedje Jaystaman, and the electrifying Caipbby, whose unmatched stage presence promises to bring the house down. Keeping the energy going all night will be DJ Edy, coming directly from Praia, Cabo Verde, for his first U.S. performance, alongside DJ Pedrito. From established favorites to the artists shaping the next wave of Cabo Verdean music, SUMMER FLOW is a celebration of Cabo Verdean sound, culture, and energy to close out the summer.
